name: IbouBot
description: The original crawler of Ibou, the French conversational search engine run by Babbar. It discovers publicly accessible pages and indexes them so Ibou can cite and link back to the sites it answers from. The operator documents a 5-second politeness delay per host (2.5 seconds per IP within a domain), publishes its address ranges as JSON, and documents forward-confirmed reverse DNS as the reliable way to tell a genuine request from a spoofed user agent. The same operator separately documents four newer 2.0 crawlers (ibou-search, ibou-discovery, ibou-images, ibou-news) on its crawlers page.
